question: Does SGD connector approval cover business USD accounts?

claims.text:
[SYNTHETIC]
Singapore business USD accounts require a separate connector approval; SGD approval does not include USD.

[SYNTHETIC]
The Atlas connector supports Singapore business SGD accounts, not personal accounts.

Atlas account eligibility
Account	Scope

 Singapore business SGD 	 Pilot supported 

 Personal SGD 	 Not supported

[SYNTHETIC]
Same-day settlement is approved for Singapore SGD pilot accounts; MYR accounts are outside this scope.

[SYNTHETIC]
INT-210 implementation is Done; commercial launch remains Pending approval. Owner: Noor.
Payment-retry remains a controlled pilot. No GA date is confirmed; use the capability page and release approval.

[SYNTHETIC]
Atlas approval covers the Singapore pilot only. Malaysia expansion has no confirmed approval date.
Release decision: controlled pilot approved. General availability (GA) not approved. PAY-102 Done is not customer release approval.
Payment-retry is available only to the controlled pilot. General availability (GA) is not approved. No general release date is confirmed.
